extensions.question_or_target: Implement the renderer that turns an internal error into three user-facing lines — what happened, what it means for the user, and the exact next command — suppressing stack traces unless a debug flag is set, and never printing a secret value or a raw internal path the user cannot act on.
extensions.sample_render_default:
What happened: An internal plugin error was raised during the operation. (planted [redacted-secret] at [redacted-path])
What it means: The user-facing message hides stack traces and secrets unless debug is on.
Next command: python3 tools/plugin/message_renderer.py --list-codes
extensions.title: User-facing message renderer (cause, impact, exact next command)

negative_controls.description: Parser must reject a message whose impact value is empty.
Grep detector must hit planted secrets when redact=False.
With --debug the stack trace IS present; without --debug it is absent. Proves suppression is conditional, not an empty branch.
